subject: Helio Cloud — multi-region dedicated capacity handover and sizing
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Helio Cloud — initial ask: multi-region handover and sizing

Team —

Quick summary: Helio Cloud (related account below) is ready to move from PoC to committed Dedicated capacity starting in Q3. Procurement just signed a conditional SOW (attached: Helio_SOW_v3.pdf). They want a multi-region deployment with predictable latency and capacity guarantees: primary traffic in US, steady growth in EU, and an immediate APAC presence (Singapore) for a subset of customers.

Key asks from Sales/Procurement:
- Initial committed pool (target): 40 GPUs (US), 24 GPUs (EU), 32 GPUs (APAC) — they used broad numbers in the SOW; we need a refined sizing proposal.
- Preferred hardware: they asked about H100 for APAC model inference but are open to A100/80GB for US/EU if it materially reduces lead time/cost.
- Canary plan: one small canary zone in APAC for week-long soak (10–15% traffic) before full cutover.
- SLA expectations: 99th p95/p99 latency SLOs to be confirmed; procurement requested latency numbers up-front.
- Timeline: target provision and handover window is Aug 1–Aug 15 to match their customer onboarding.

Please review and size based on model mix below (Rishi will add estimates). Primary asks for this thread: concrete GPU counts per region with recommended instance types, estimated timeframe (lead time + infra approvals), and any blockers (quota, HSM/KMS, cross-region data retention).

I've pasted the SOW and the Sales MA (HubSpot HS-128372) in links.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Helio_SOW_v3.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helio Cloud — initial ask: multi-region handover and sizing

On Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 08:15, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> Quick summary: Helio Cloud ...

Thanks Mina — adding the model/traffic context they shared in the discovery call:
- Model mix: 65% small-dialogue/chat completions (context window ~2048), 25% long-form summarization (context up to 8k), 10% embeddings/batch rerank.
- Expected sustained qps: US (20 r/s), EU (8 r/s), APAC (6 r/s) at month 1; ramp multiplies x2–x3 over 3 months for paid customers.
- Peak concurrency assumptions: assume 200 concurrent sessions per region initially; prefetch/prefix caching will reduce token work for reruns.

Sizing quick takes (ballpark; need infra input):
- US: 40 x A100-80GB (or 30 A100 + 10 H100 for mixed QPS/throughput) to meet throughput + hot-cache requirements.
- EU: 24 x A100-80GB (good fit for region and cost).
- APAC: Recommend 16 x H100 (for long-form summarization) + 16 x A100 for steady-state mix — total 32. If procurement insists on all-H100, lead time/cost spike.

Operational notes:
- Suggest enabling prefix/KV caching in US first to reduce token cost at scale.
- Canary traffic shard: route 10% of APAC traffic to a 4-GPU canary cluster (H100-lite) for 7 days; monitor 95/99 latency and model quality regressions.
- Quantization strategy: recommend int8 for chat paths where quality delta acceptable; keep full-precision for long-form summarization until evals finish.

I'll drop a simple perf-to-GPU mapping (rps per GPU by model class) after cross-checking with bench infra.

—Rishi

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helio Cloud — initial ask: multi-region handover and sizing

+1 on Rishi's recommendations. A few procurement/operational constraints to flag:
- Procurement window: Helio expects a tight procurement approval; we should confirm their legal/PO timeline. Procurement asked if we can start billing on committed capacity only after handover. That affects reservation dates.
- Security/compliance: they requested SOC 2 evidence and KMS/HSM integration info for the Private deployment option. We should prepare a short artifact list (SOC2 report, KMS integration doc, network isolation diagram).
- DC/region blockers: EU (Ireland) has some additional IP allowlist steps; APAC (Singapore) requires a local nodal connectivity test for their carrier.
- Quota: we have limited H100 inventory in APAC for August; if they insist on H100-heavy pool we may need a lead-time exception or a tranching plan.

Action request: Priyom, can you run a H100 availability check for the APAC region and return earliest ship dates? Laura — can you own the SOC2/KMS packet we send to procurement? I'll draft the procurement answers once we have availability and confirmed SLA asks.

—Tessa
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Marin <sofia@helioscloud.com>, procurement@helioscloud.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Helio Cloud — multi-region dedicated capacity handover and sizing

Hi Sofia / Helio procurement —

Forwarding our internal sizing thread so you can confirm a few items we need to finalize the SOW and schedule:
1) Can you confirm the expected traffic mix and the planned ramp (month-by-month) so we can finalize counts? Rishi pasted his assumptions below.
2) Helio requested a canary approach in APAC — are you comfortable with a 7-day 10–15% soak, and do you have a preferred window in August?
3) Confirm SLOs you expect (95/99 latency targets by model class).

Procurement asked specifically for: preferred billing start (on-hand-over vs start-of-commit), and any required certificates for KMS/SOC2. Laura is looping the compliance packet.

If you prefer a short call to run through the mutual action plan, we can do 30 minutes tomorrow.

Thanks — Mina

Mina —

Thanks for the forward and the clear breakdown. Confirming a few points from Helio:
- Traffic/ramp: the sales forecast (conservative) matches Rishi's assumptions: month 1 baseline US: 20 r/s, EU: 8 r/s, APAC: 6 r/s; ramp expected x2 over 3 months.
- Canary: yes, 7-day soak targeting August 9–15 would work for our onboarding plan.
- SLA: we'll target p95 < 300ms and p99 < 800ms for chat flows; long-form summarization p95 < 1.2s. If you can provide historical p99s from similar customers (US/EU/APAC) that would help.
- Hardware preferences: we'd prefer H100 in APAC for performance headroom but accept a hybrid approach if lead times are shorter.
- Compliance: procurement needs SOC2 Type II report and a KMS integration diagram. We've attached a mutual action plan (Helios_MA_Plan.xlsx) with suggested milestones.

Next steps from our side: procurement will confirm the billing start (they prefer billing to begin after handover). We'll also kick off a short compliance questionnaire today.

Regards,
Sofia Marin
Director of Platform Operations, Helio Cloud

Attachments: Helios_MA_Plan.xlsx
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Helio handover — internal summary & next steps

Team —

Summary of the window and next steps after Helio confirmation:
- Consensus sizing (initial commitment): US: 36 A100-80GB; EU: 24 A100-80GB; APAC: 28 GPUs (16 H100 + 12 A100) as hybrid approach to balance lead time and perf.
- Canary: APAC 4-GPU H100 canary (10% traffic) Aug 9–15.
- Billing start: procurement prefers billing after handover; commercial will confirm contract language for the reservation term.
- Compliance artifacts: Laura to deliver SOC2, KMS integration doc, and network isolation diagram to procurement (target: 48h).
- Availability check: Priyom to confirm H100 earliest ship dates and whether we can reserve the APAC tranche (target: EOD Tue 2027-04-27).
- Infra readiness: Rishi to produce perf->GPU mapping and an expected token-cost delta matrix for the hybrid APAC approach (target: Apr 29).

Blockers/risks: limited H100 inventory in APAC for Aug; if availability misses target we will propose a tranching plan (start with 12 H100 + 12 A100 and move to full H100 by Nov). Also need to confirm EU network allowlist timeline.

I'll prepare a short handover packet to send to Helio after we have Priyom's availability confirmation and Laura's compliance packet.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
